activity_log_enabled.description: QoS suite: record every action the suite's mods actually take (commands scheduled, navigations) to the shared activity feed (%APPDATA%\Captain of Industry\QoS\events-v1.jsonl), which the CoI Companion website imports into its Log page. Recording is independent of the per-feature log verbosity settings. Turn off to stop the feed growing; already-recorded events stay recorded.

verbose_logging.description: QoS suite: log diagnostic detail (per-pass decisions, skip reasons) in addition to actions taken.
